## What's Changed
* Upgrade to phpunit 9 and drop php 7.2 support by @DIOHz0r in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/33
* Update .gitattributes with .github by @KasperFranz in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/34
* .gitignore: ignore PHPUnit cache file by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/36
* Tests: add missing `@covers` tag by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/41
* GH Actions: simplify Composer caching by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/39
* Phive: upgrade to use latest version of Phive by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/40
* GH Actions: allow for manually triggering a workflow by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/38
* Psalm: switch from Phive to Composer by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/42
* GH Actions: fail the build if a test run fails by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/43
* Phive: upgrade used version of PHPUnit by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/45
* GH Actions: start testing against PHP 8.1 by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/44
* CS update after upstream changes by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/46
* Bump psalm/phar from 4.8.1 to 4.9.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/47
* Bump psalm/phar from 4.9.2 to 4.9.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/48
* Bump psalm/phar from 4.9.3 to 4.10.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/49
* Bump psalm/phar from 4.10.0 to 4.12.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/53
* PHPUnit: update configuration by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/50
* GH Actions: version update for `ramsey/composer-install` by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/58
* Bump psalm/phar from 4.12.0 to 4.16.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/60
* Bump psalm/phar from 4.16.1 to 4.17.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/61
* GH Actions: version update for various predefined actions by @jrfnl in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/67
* Use HTTPS protocol for homepage by @ArnaudLier in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/69
* Modernize ci by @jaapio in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/72
* Build on php 8.2 by @jaapio in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/73
* Bump phpDocumentor/.github from 0.1.0 to 0.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/74
* Bump phpDocumentor/.github from 0.3.0 to 0.5.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/75
* Test against php 8.3 and 8.4 by @sergiy-petrov in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/78
* Bump phpDocumentor/.github from 0.5.0 to 0.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/77
* Bump phpDocumentor/.github from 0.7 to 0.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/79
* Bump phpDocumentor/.github/.github/workflows/static-analysis.yml from 0.8 to 0.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/84
* Bump phpDocumentor/.github/.github/workflows/continuous-integration.yml from 0.8 to 0.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/83

## New Contributors
* @DIOHz0r made their first contribution in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/33
* @KasperFranz made their first contribution in https://github.com/phpDocumentor/ReflectionCommon/pull/34
* @jrfnl made
